summary: Batch#30 (TRUSTED HELPERS Phase 1) — full regression. BACKEND: 24/24 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_batch30_trusted_helpers.py covering (1) Parent CRUD: POST /helpers invite-mode returns invite_code & status='pending'; POST /helpers direct-mode with username+pin returns status='active' & invite_code=null; PATCH renames + updates permissions overrides; GET /helpers/{id}; DELETE followed by GET returns 404. (2) Lifecycle: pause → helper login rejected (401/403), resume → login works again; regenerate-invite yields a NEW code different from the previous; reset-pin sets new username+pin (old creds fail, new creds succeed); signout-all → previously-issued helper token now 401 on /helper/me; remove → old helper token 401 and login 401. (3) Helper self: /helper/me & /helper/dashboard return Sunita + 3 daily tasks (breakfast, school pickup w/ photo proof, tidy room); start/complete non-proof task OK; complete pickup task WITHOUT photo → 400 as spec; WITH photo_url → 200; /helper/tasks/{id}/issue with reason+note → 200. (4) Parent → helper task assignment: POST /helpers/{id}/tasks with schedule=daily, category=pickup, for_member_id=Aarav, require_proof=note → immediately visible on helper /dashboard; /helpers/{id}/activity 200. (5) SECURITY (critical, all pass): helper token → 401 on /home, /families/me, /chats, /vault/folders (parameterised); family token → 401 on /helper/me, /helper/dashboard, /helper/tasks; unauthenticated → 401 on GET/POST /helpers. (6) Child scoping: demo helper Sunita's assigned_member_ids contains Aarav but NOT Anaya. FRONTEND (Playwright at 390x844, mobile): (A) Helper flow: Welcome → helper-portal-link → helper-login (sunita/1234) → /helper-portal shows exactly 3 htask-* cards including 'Pick up Aarav from school' badged 'Photo needed' (9 total 'Photo needed' hint occurrences correctly rendered on the proof-required card). Sign-out returns user to /helper-login (helper-username visible again). (B) Parent flow (storytester@fam.com): tab-family → 'Trusted Helpers' section header + add-helper-cta visible (screenshot). Add-helper wizard: filled helper-name → role-cook → assign-all → access-permanent → login-invite → add-helper-submit → success screen shows invite-code 'BC7D9EDAB2' + invite-link + Done. invite-done → routed to /helper/[id] detail: Access Summary correctly shows granted (tasks, meals, shopping, chat, home_instructions) with check icon and denied (calendar, child_schedule, emergency_contacts, medical, documents, location, pickup_drop) with x-icon. assign-task-btn opens task modal → filled task-title 'TEST_UI_Task', sched-daily, cat-chore, proof-none → task-submit → task 'TEST_UI_Task Every day' appears in Tasks list (verified by DOM query). regen-invite-btn / set-login-btn / remove-btn visible. pause-btn is correctly HIDDEN for a pending/invited helper (only shown for active) — per source. Cleaned up TEST_UI_Helper via DELETE /api/helpers/{id}. NO react-native or expo deprecation issues detected in the batch#30 code paths. NOTE: helper proof-photo image upload from web could not be exercised (web has no native image picker) — this is the documented native-only limitation and does NOT block the build. The proof-requirement UI ('Photo needed' hint + photo box in the Done modal) rendered correctly.
action_items: None blocking. Optional polish: (1) The pause-btn is only rendered when helper.status==='active' — for an invited/pending helper, only 'Remove' is available. If parents should be able to freeze a pending invitation (e.g. lost invite code they haven't shared yet), consider showing pause for status==='pending' too or renaming the primary action to 'Revoke invite'. (2) A benign React warning fires on Home tab: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop. Check the render method of View. It was passed a child from TasksSection.' Not a helper-flow issue but worth fixing at some point.

Suggest adding a testID on the leaf task-list row in helper detail (currently the created task text is only findable by textContent scan) — e.g. testID=`helper-task-${task_id}` on the parent-view task rows, matching the existing testID=`task-${task_id}` pattern in the file so future tests can select without a text scan.
critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY boundary in server.py:253 (top-level get_current_user) correctly short-circuits helper tokens with 401 before any family route runs — verified by pytest across /home, /families/me, /chats, /vault/folders. Well done.

helper_login rate-limits by ip+username (server.py:6520+); the current test doesn't exercise the throttle, but code inspection shows the correct pattern with locked_until per doc. Consider unit-testing the throttle path with a mock clock in a future iteration.

Complete endpoint (server.py:6602+) enforces require_proof=='photo' → 400 when body.photo_url missing — matches spec exactly. Photo URL is stored verbatim so caller should ensure the URL is a helper_uploads URL from /api/helper/upload for tamper resistance (currently the endpoint accepts any string, which is fine for Phase 1 but should be validated in a later phase).

helper add wizard (/app/frontend/app/helper/add.tsx) — good UX: role picking auto-populates permission defaults (locked=true when granted by role), so parents Deny by tapping to override. testIDs are comprehensive.

helper detail Access Summary is generated purely from helper.permissions map — a helper that had 'chat' granted then denied on PATCH will correctly move from can to cannot section on next fetch. Good.
The frontend 'Trusted Helpers' preview text on Family tab correctly uses AppText (React Native Text) not raw HTML span, and add-helper-cta uses Pressable — RN-compliant.
